transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As we discussed at the readiness huddle, we have one Saturday mobile vaccination clinic available this month, and it can operate at either the Eastside Community Center or the Westside Library. Before I make the final activation decision and sign the operational plan, I need each of you to report your requirements: public health nursing, I need your clinical requirements; pharmacy logistics, I need your supply requirements; and community outreach, I need your access requirements. Once I have those, I'll be able to approve the site and get the plan finalized.

transcript.text: I need to share important clinical requirements. The county's updated allocation list, which I received this morning from the county nurse coordinator, records 31 children aged six months through four years in the Eastside service area. County policy requires that the Saturday session serving that pediatric group use the pediatric mRNA formulation at Eastside Community Center. So from a public health nursing standpoint, our clinical requirements point specifically to Eastside Community Center with the pediatric mRNA formulation.

I've already verified the refrigerator record with facilities, so Eastside is ready from a cold-chain and supply standpoint.
